name: fp8-numerics

engine.version: none: CPU oracle emulation (oracle/fp8_emu.py), no engine involved

tests.filter: A lane through the fp8 harness equals the engine fixture bitwise (3 prompts)
raw-long-window (1,119 rows) and chat-capital-effort0, real inputs, 7 variants, all dense calls + 5 MoE visits
gate (b): fp8 added deviation <= A-lane floor at every visit (f8_row, 3 prompts)

commands: nice -n 19 python oracle/fp8_emu.py layers --pack PACK --fixture <tokens of raw-long-window> --out layers-long.json --workers 5 --threads 2 --weight-cache-gib 12
nice -n 19 python oracle/fp8_emu.py layers --pack PACK --fixture <chat-capital-effort0> --out layers-chat-capital.json --workers 3 --threads 1 --weight-cache-gib 6

nice -n 19 python oracle/fp8_emu.py forward --pack PACK --fixture <prompt> --variant <v> --out fwd/<v>-<prompt>.safetensors --workers 4 --threads 2 (v in A f8_row f8_blk128 f8_row_tile f8_wt f8_act_row; prompts chat-capital-effort0 chat-sky-effort0.9 raw-counting)
python oracle/fp8_summary.py --spec fixtures/spec --engine fixtures/engine --runs fwd --prompts chat-capital-effort0 chat-sky-effort0.9 raw-counting --out summary.json
notes: fail = the decision gate's condition (b) does not hold; the measurements are complete. CPU only on node-4 (torch float8_e4m3fn emulation, float64 standing for fp32 accumulation, as the oracle's own fp16 emulations). The 1,119-token prompt was probed at the op level only (all dense calls, MoE of visits 1, 8, 28, 40, 46); the whole-forward propagation used the three short prompts (40, 49, 50 teacher-forced rows). lab dir: lab/inkling2-mini-k-fp8 on node-4.
